demo.title: inspect-offer.sh
demo.code:
# Inspect one BTC/ETH snapshot for free. An empty window returns no offer.
curl -q -sS 'https://futurecast.ml85.xyz/api/v1/x402/signals/btc-eth-snapshot?utm_source=bankr' | jq '{accepts, detail}'

setup: For one frozen BTC/ETH snapshot, inspect availability free. An approved x402 purchase costs 0.05 USDC. MCP v1.4.0 supports inspect_btc_eth_snapshot and buy_or_resume_btc_eth_snapshot.
Inspect the unsigned day-pass offer using Python 3 or the unsigned curl example.
Use an existing private pass file to read snapshots. A new 24-hour pass costs 5 USDC on Base.
Filter by token and direction. Track detection times to suppress duplicate alerts.
For revisioned events or budgeted MCP checkout, see https://github.com/Marcolist/neuraliquid-mcp. Use buy_or_resume_pass and read_agent_events.
